title: Canberra als Kompromiss
narration: Die Lösung war Canberra: eine neu geplante Hauptstadt als Kompromiss zwischen den Rivalen.
visualIdea: Australia sphere places a new capital pin at Canberra between the rival city icons; the composition emphasizes a neutral compromise and a deliberately planned federal capital.
continuityNotes: Maintain the same round-country-character world, paper texture, line weight and color system established by Bild 00.
